messages:
Rina - Marketing: Quick lane check for Friday's release. I need (1) stable changelog URL, (2) canonical docs URL (no redirects), (3) webinar time + embargo, (4) UTMs + lead tag. Single-line replies please.

Carlos - Eng: changelog: https://redwood-inference.dev/changelog/2026-09-08-release. All infra patches merged. Canary planned post-deploy. No blockers.

Marta - Docs: docs canonical: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/releases/2026-09-08. I'll publish the how-to once Carlos posts the tiny example (ETA 30m).

Carlos - Eng: snippet (use exactly):
```js
// docs/blog sample
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/smarty-13b', prompt: 'Summarize the release highlights', max_tokens: 100 });
console.log(out.text);
```
Canary tested.

Owen - Growth: Webinar booked 16:00 PT (join 15:55). Recommend embargo lift 15:55 PT. UTMs: utm_campaign=sep08_release&utm_source=webinar. Lead tag: release_sep08. I'll push final modal and tracking snippet to #growth.

Rina - Marketing: Carlos, if deploy starts at 11:00 PT will canary finish before 15:55? Need docs + blog live by embargo.

Carlos - Eng: Deploy plan: 11:00 deploy -> 11:00-11:30 canary -> 11:30-12:30 staged rollout -> 13:00 full traffic. Good buffer for 15:55. Rollback path tested. If p95 > 2.5x baseline or error rate > 0.6% during canary we rollback.

Marta - Docs: Once snippet merged I'll publish docs by 13:30 PT. That gives marketing time to proof and set links.

Owen - Growth: Landing copy draft: "Live demo: see Redwood's latency + cost wins. Register." Will post final modal + tracking in #growth in 20m.

Rina - Marketing: Final publish plan if green: 15:55 PT blog + changelog + docs go live, 16:00 PT webinar starts, 16:05 PT social posts queue. Who will publish the blog at embargo?

Carlos - Eng: I'll monitor canary and post status here. Oncall will be looped. +1 infra.

Marta - Docs: +1 to review blog copy for doc accuracy after publish. I'll post live docs link here when done.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Carlos at 6901122000. Artifact: artifact-sep08-2026.tgz. Canary and rollout config applied.

Rina - Marketing: Thanks all. Please react to acknowledge this thread as source-of-truth for publish timing. :white_check_mark:
